note: P4359 (Pro 29:27) — an unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; the upright, to the wicked.

dims.v: the unjust man who is an abomination to the righteous — injustice that the righteous cannot stomach, the mutual antipathy between good and evil seen from the righteous side
the upright it is set against (266881)
set against the upright man abhorred by the wicked

avel (injustice/the unjust) — 'an UNJUST man is an abomination to the righteous'; the good loathe injustice as the wicked loathe uprightness. Moral character breeds mutual antipathy between the two camps (cf 29:27b).
the man whose way is straight, who is an abomination to the wicked — uprightness that the wicked cannot bear, the mutual antipathy between good and evil seen from the wicked side
the unjust man it is set against (266876)
set against the unjust man abhorred by the righteous

yashar (upright/straight) — 'but one whose way is straight is an abomination to the WICKED'; the wicked loathe the upright as the righteous loathe the unjust. Light and darkness are mutually repugnant — each side an abomination to the other.
